# GrantDeskHQ

GrantDeskHQ is AI-powered post-award grant reporting software for nonprofit finance, grants, program, and review teams.

The product turns award agreements, approved budget data, general-ledger exports, program updates, funder forms, and supporting evidence into a source-linked reporting workflow. It extracts reporting obligations, calculates budget-to-actual schedules deterministically, links narrative claims to their sources, reconciles supporting evidence, and surfaces the few decisions that require professional judgment.

GrantDeskHQ does not submit reports to funders or replace accounting, legal, audit, or compliance review.

- Free readiness audit: https://grantdeskhq.com/readiness
- Privacy and data handling: https://grantdeskhq.com/privacy

## Audience

Nonprofit organizations and grant-funded teams that manage restricted grants, post-award reporting, financial schedules, program metrics, supporting evidence, and funder compliance.
